source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What should a skill's description communicate?

options.text: Its folder size and creation time
options.feedback: Those details describe a saved folder, but they do not explain whether its procedure fits your task.

options.text: Its complete procedure and every example
options.feedback: The full procedure belongs in the instructions loaded after selection. The description offers a shorter basis for choosing.

options.text: Its outcome and when it applies
options.feedback: The description helps connect a requested task with an appropriate reusable procedure.

options.text: Its latest input and generated output
options.feedback: Those describe one run. The description should characterize the recurring work the skill handles.
